item.title: Derby dessert café temporarily closed amid health investigation
item.description: A dessert café in Derby city centre has temporarily closed amid a health investigation. Major café chain Heavenly Desserts on London Road next to Derbion shopping centre is currently shut down. A sign on the front entrance states the venue is closed due to “essential repairs”. item.title: Nottinghamshire drugs gang jailed for 90 years after investigation into fentanyl-laced ‘super heroin’
item.description: A gang responsible for peddling drugs, including a ‘super heroin’, across the streets of Nottinghamshire has been jailed for almost 90 years combined.
